crossRefs.note: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

translations.web: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.
translations.bsb: So Noah came out, along with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.
translations.kjv: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives
translations.asv: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
